cues.text: A hospital room. Chidori sits up in bed with a sketchbook open on her lap. Mitsuru sits on a stool beside the bed with her arms crossed, and Akihiko stands by the window.
Junpei hurries in and stops beside the bed. Yukari comes in after him.
Chidori lets go of the sketchbook and doubles over in the bed, burying her face in her arms.
